body: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.
summaryZh: 本研究探讨了通过持续预训练将大语言模型适配到瑞典新闻这一垂直领域的全过程。研究团队使用数百万新闻文章构建高质量数据集，并通过全量微调和参数高效微调发现，持续预训练可以显著提升目标领域的生成质量和事实知识，但必须配合经验回放（Experience Replay）以缓解灾难性遗忘。此外，针对训练无关的指令遵循方法的探索也展示了低秩适应带来的额外收益。

glossary.explanationZh: 持续预训练，在已有通用基础模型的基础上使用特定领域语料继续进行预训练以实现领域适配
经验回放，在模型微调时混入部分原领域或通用数据，用以防止模型遗忘原有能力
参数高效微调，仅训练少量参数即可调整模型行为的技术（如LoRA）
低秩适应（LoRA），一种常用的参数高效微调方法
